counterEvidence.visualDefects: 19 check boxes print with a doubled or misregistered border that the Illinois Supreme Court's own form does not print. Structural cause read from the delivered bytes: flatten() stamped 91 FlatWidget appearance XObjects whose entire stream is a black stroked rectangle at the widget /Rect - '0 0 0 RG / 0 w / 0 0 m / 0 12.113 l / 12.0867 12.113 l / 12.0867 0 l / h / S' - one for every unchecked check box in the packet. 72 of the 91 land on top of the form's own printed box and add no visible mark; 19 are misregistered enough to print a separate hairline, confirmed by directional raster diff against the blank sources at 300 dpi: Request p3 x4 (right edges of the 6ab and 9ab widget pairs), p4 x1 (the item 12 No box, whose bottom edge prints 12.5 pt of ink the form does not carry), p5 x4 (including Section 15), p6 x1, FW-CIV p1 x1, p2 x1, p3 x7. Each detected rule sits exactly at a widget /Rect edge and matches its width or height to within a pixel. The FIX80 scanner reports this family clean because its predicate requires /MK /BC, and all 94 check-box widgets across the four Illinois sources carry /MK /BC = null; pdf-lib strokes black regardless. That is the structural-versus-raster disagreement resolved from the bytes.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The registry track names eight selfHelpStopConditions. The delivered '## Stop and get help' section carries four: objection by the State's Attorney, ISP, arresting agency or chief legal officer; a contested hearing; eligibility facts that do not match; and immigration consequences. Four are absent from the delivered guide: 'A case appears on the transcript that the participant does not recognize, which may indicate identity theft'; 'The participant has federal or out-of-state records, which an Illinois court cannot reach'; 'A motion to vacate, modify or reconsider is filed under 5.2(d)(12)'; and 'The petition is denied'. The out-of-state omission bites hardest on this track: its own release blocker records that the two-year clock runs from termination of the last sentence 'in any jurisdiction' while the ISP transcript will not show out-of-state sentences, so the participant most needing to be told to stop is the one the guide does not address.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: Registry destination: 'Circuit clerk of the county of arrest or charge. File with the circuit clerk in each county where an arrest occurred or a charge was brought.' The guide says exactly that, adds the Cook County district instruction and the AOIC flattening requirement, and states the clerk performs service under 5.2(d)(4).

SERVICE.detail: The guide names the actor (the circuit clerk, 5.2(d)(4)), the recipients (State's Attorney, Illinois State Police, arresting agency, and the chief legal officer for municipal ordinance violations), the 60-day objection window under 5.2(d)(5)(B), the default order under 5.2(d)(6)(B), and states plainly 'You serve nobody.'

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: The ten record lines are present verbatim - all 10 of 10 confirmed by exact string containment against packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling, so FIX13 holds and the fingerprint-based ISP transcript is now named as a document to obtain. The failure is what the same section then adds. Under 'Every item this packet leaves for you' and the sentence 'Do not sign until the packet is complete', the guide prints eleven further pre-filing obligations: 'Complete arrest60 on EXP-AD Case List page 1' through 'Complete arrest70'. production-field-map.json classifies Case List slots arrest2 through arrest59 as OPTIONAL_PARTICIPANT_CONTENT ('Unused additional-record slot ... every unused row remains wholly blank') and the eleven identical slots arrest60 through arrest70 as REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with requiredBeforeFiling: true. They are the same kind of slot on the same 70-row table, and the split is arbitrary. A petitioner with one sealed case is told to complete eleven rows that nothing requires, named by raw AcroForm field ids they cannot interpret. Measured on the delivered guide, not on the ledger.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The county circuit clerk fee, the $60 ISP order-processing fee and the Supreme Court Rule 298 waiver are all stated in the record's own words, and the fee waiver component is delivered as pages 10-13. Recorded as an observation rather than a failure: the same registry track carries a release blocker reading 'a county fee table must be built before a fee figure is shown to a participant', and the guide shows '$60 to $235; McLean County publishes $136' because packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling itself contains that sentence. The record speaks with two voices here, and FIX13's instruction to print the ten lines verbatim is what surfaced the figure. buildBlockers is empty and this is a release gate, not a build gate, so it is routed to the integrator rather than scored.

observations: 46 blank fee-waiver elections are classified in the refusal ledger as participant elections but never reach the participant guide, which lists 58 dollar-amount blanks on the same form and none of the check boxes beside them. Among the omitted are Section 1A 'I am completing this form: for myself / on behalf of a minor', all five Section 3 public-benefit boxes, and the page-2 STOP routing that decides whether the filer qualifies for a full waiver under 735 ILCS 5/5-105(a)(2)(i), (b)(1). A filer following the guide would enter amounts beside unchecked boxes.

No obligation among the fifteen names 'ink the official form does not print'. The 19 synthesized widget borders are therefore carried in the visualDefects counter with their evidence rather than forced into CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP, which they do not fit: nothing is clipped and nothing overlaps printed ink.

The condition has a named remediation already in this sprint, the suppressSynthesizedWidgetBorders option under FIX80. Its scanner does not flag this family because its predicate requires /MK /BC, which none of these widgets carries. The predicate, not the family, is what reports clean.
